title: Article
description: One news article as produced by the Silver/Gold Spark jobs and stored in the articles table. Consumed by exports, retrieval, the API and evaluation.
$comment: Frozen 2026-11-02 (Phase 2). Change only through an approved issue; update infra/postgres/migrations and the contract tests in the same PR. Optional fields stay null or empty when the source does not provide them: never invent metadata.

article_id.description: Stable id: hex SHA-256 (or a prefix of at least 16 chars) of the canonical source_url.

content.description: Cleaned article body in its original language. Stored for internal processing and retrieval; never shown in full to users.

summary.description: Summary given by the source (RSS description) or the first sentences of the body. Never generated by an LLM.

source_url.description: Canonical original article URL (tracking parameters removed).

published_at.description: Publication time from the source, converted to UTC (RFC 3339). Null when the source gives none.

collected_at.description: When the collector fetched the item, UTC (RFC 3339). Always set; separate from published_at.

language.description: Detected ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. vi, en, es, fr.

sport_category.description: From the trained sport classifier (Model A) or the source section.

content_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the normalized title + body; used for exact deduplication.

story_cluster_id.description: Near-duplicate group from MinHashLSH in the Silver job; the same story from different outlets shares it.
